{{Quote|As the Emperor wills it, so shall it be.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope (novel)">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The title of '''emperor''' (feminine '''empress''') was held by certain officials and heads of state in certain governments. It was usually, but not always, inherited. Sometimes successful [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] and conquerors created empires by declaring themselves emperor.

==Usage==
[[Emperor (Tapani)|Emperor]] [[Shey Tapani]] founded the [[Tapani Empire]] around [[7328 BBY]]. Empress [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|united]] the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. After her [[Death/Legends|death]], the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was renamed for her in honor of her memory.

The title was also used in certain other quarters. [[Uueg Tching]] was the fifty-forth Emperor of [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]], and [[Antbbianplourr III]] was Emperor of [[Eiattu 6]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. [[Belgoa]] was Emperor of [[Trunska]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] was the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] following the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], and later Emperor of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] as Valkorion. [[Darth Malgus]] was the claimant Sith Emperor and ruler of the [[New Empire]] movement in [[3640 BBY]]. [[Arcann]] was the Emperor of [[Zakuul]] and the [[Eternal Empire]] between [[3636 BBY]] and [[3630 BBY]], while [[Vaylin]] was Empress of [[Zakuul]] and the [[Eternal Empire]] in [[3630 BBY]]. [[Darth Acina]] was empress of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|the Sith]] during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] and the subsequent [[War against Zakuul|uprising]]. [[Darth Vowrawn]] was Acina's successor and launched the [[third Galactic War]].

[[File:MarasiahFel.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Marasiah Fel, Empress]]
Assuming power of the galaxy in 19 BBY, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was the leader of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was usually just referred to as "''the'' Emperor." As the Empire's power and influence diminished following the Emperor's death in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], however, the title became less important, and by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] onwards, the Empire was effectively headed by the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] in a military [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictatorship]]. The power of the throne was eventually restored under the [[Fel dynasty]]: [[Jagged Fel]] was the first Emperor of the [[Fel Empire]], taking power around [[44 ABY]]. His successor was [[Fel II]], while the third emperor was [[Roan Fel]], reigning between around [[127 ABY]] to [[138 ABY]]. [[Darth Krayt]] became Emperor of his own [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] in [[130 ABY]] and ruled until around [[138 ABY]]; at the time, the Fel Empire was under the command of Empress [[Marasiah Fel]].

==Behind the scenes==
The title of emperor was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]] and published in [[1976]].

The player character in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', known as [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], has the choice of either becoming a diplomat, unifying the Sith Empire and Republic in the Eternal Alliance through diplomacy, or taking the new title Eternal Emperor (the previous title was Immortal Emperor), unifying the galaxy through force.
